notes.title: tweaked jump and fixed audio bugs
notes.notes:
jump is less linear and more cutoff-y now to better reflect visuals, also visuals delayed

and fixed some bugs with audio not swapping correctly.

notes.title: BIG JUMPS!
notes.notes:
A lot of people where struggling with similar bits, and i didnt want to add saves because i really wanted it to be completed in one sitting

So im hoping this will put the difficulty in a nicer spot :D

Cat ledge and saloon seem to filter a lot of people early on

And even the tree people seemed to find frustrating to go back to

Now you can do cool loops

And clear the tree in one shot :D

And the old filters become a lot more managable.

Hope people enjoy it :D

notes.title: Spectator mode and general fixes
notes.notes:
Once your in a lobby, a spectate next button should appeal now

If there is more then one person in a lobby it should cycle through each player that isnt your self on press 

Testing has been messy though, so if theres any bugs please let me know

Also other general fixes like your health shows when fighting the boss now, and some text pop-in has been reduced
